general.description: Swept RAE 2822 section (2.5D), SA: M 0.842, alpha 2 deg, sweep 30 deg, Re 6.5e6

domain.notes: The RAE 2822 as the section normal to the sweep line, so the in-plane Mach number and incidence are those of AGARD case 6 (0.730, 2.31 deg). For a wing defined by streamwise sections, leave 'section' at its default, 'streamwise': the grid is then scaled by cos(sweep) along x. docs/swept.md.

freestream.notes: Mach number and incidence of the whole freestream, in the streamwise plane; the spanwise velocity is M cos(alpha) sin(sweep).
